description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more resource groups
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-db-resource-group --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --resource-group-name testgroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specified region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

If this parameter is omitted, details for all resource groups are returned. Otherwise, only details for the specified resource group are returned
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
当该值为空时，返回所有资源组详情；当该值不为空，则返回指定资源组详情
parameters.name: resource_group_name

ResourceGroupConfig.description_en:
The configuration of the resource group.

`CpuRateLimit`: The percentage of CPU resources that the resource group can use. Unit: %.

`MemoryLimit`: The percentage of memory resources that the resource group can use. Unit: %.

`MemorySharedQuota`: The percentage of memory resources that can be shared among transactions in the resource group. Unit: %. Default value: 80.

`MemorySpillRatio`: The memory usage threshold for memory-intensive transactions. When a transaction reaches this threshold, it spills data to disk. Unit: %. Default value: 0.

`Concurrency`: The maximum concurrency for the resource group. Default value: 20
ResourceGroupConfig.description_zh:
资源组配置。
CpuRateLimit：资源组可使用cpu资源百分比，单位：%
MemoryLimit：资源组可使用内存资源百分比，单位：%
MemorySharedQuota：提交到该资源组的事务之间共享的内存资源百分比，单位：%，默认值：80
MemorySpillRatio：内存密集型事务的内存使用阈值。当事务达到此阈值时，将溢出磁盘，单位：%，默认值：0
Concurrency：资源组允许的最大并发数，默认值：20

ResourceGroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group
